svg.title: The trail of the evening: eight camps
svg.desc: A pixel-art night map. A dotted trail winds through a dark pine forest past eight small campfires, each labelled: I gathering, II old fires, III words, IV kindling, V many fires, VI vave, VII smoke, VIII embers. The fires grow along the way, smoke rises at VII and only embers glow at VIII. Stars and a crescent moon at the top.
